source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch5.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/, clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents."
